summary: Package ships browser overlay redirecting to hardcoded external URL
details: The package's declared main (px.js) is browser DOM code with no Node/library functionality. On execution in a browser context it creates a full-screen loading mask and injects a fixed-position, full-viewport iframe (z-index 2147483647) whose src is a hardcoded external URL (https://mfmz.z3jll.cn/H.html?c=0gjr). The tarball has no other functionality and the README is empty boilerplate. Installing or requiring the package does not exfiltrate data, execute code on the installer, drop persistence, or open a backdoor — the payload only runs if the file is bundled into a downstream web page, at which point end users of that page see a full-screen redirect/overlay to the hardcoded domain. The package's name does not correspond to any documented purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
